name: MFP 4-zone MFP extender PCB kit
family: Context Plus MFP Range Conventional Panels
summary: The FF501Z is a Four Zone Extender Card that is designed solely for use with the Context Plus Conventional MFP range of fire control panels. It is used to expand the FF516/CON 16 zone panel to 28 zone. It includes a 10 way Zone loom for transferring information between the circuit boards and a 5 way Zone loom for transferring the Detector circuits to the terminals in the back of the Control Panel Base.
